title: OPC 40223 - Pumps and Vacuum Pumps
catalogCoverage: sections 1-10 and annexes A-C read; section 7 covered structurally via pumps.owl.ttl, its prose sampled at 3 of 51 subsections

rules.summary: A FunctionalGroup that would be empty is not instantiated
An EngineeringUnits Property without a value is absent or Null-valued
The EngineeringUnits defaults named by the specification are used
Manufacturer extensions are organized by some FunctionalGroup
An extension does not redefine a BrowseName the specification already provides
PumpType is a TopologyElementType, so every DI TopologyElement rule applies
A ValueRank above zero requires ArrayDimensions to be specified
Common Attributes are set as Tables 4-6 specify
Methods defined by this specification are executable
An In Port connects only to an Out or InOut Port
34 Pumps ObjectTypes are FunctionalGroups, so DI's group rules govern them
PumpIdentificationType is a MachineIdentificationType, inheriting its rules
Mandatory components of the 51 ObjectTypes are present on every instance
A Variable typed by an enumeration carries a value that enumeration defines
Nodes this specification does not define stay out of the standard namespaces
The standard namespaces carry fixed namespace indices
